name: The Hologram Carousel of Forgotten Fairy Tales
description: A magical carousel where each horse is a holographic projection of different fairy tale creatures - unicorns, phoenixes, dragons, and pegasi that come alive as it spins.
prompt: magical carousel with holographic projections of fairy tale creatures instead of horses, glowing unicorns, phoenixes, dragons, and pegasi, ethereal light trails as it spins, enchanted forest background, mystical atmosphere, detailed hologram effects
caption: Round and round through stories untold 🦄🐉 Where will your ride take you in the realm of forgotten tales?
